The plate looks like a side plate of roughly 22 cm, so I scaled each item against that.

- **Rib:** about 15 cm long and 3.5 cm wide. It is a single rib section, mostly bone with some meat, so I put it at about 60 g.
- **Fried chicken pieces:** two pieces, one about 7 cm and one about 6 cm, roughly 3 cm thick. Together they come to about 70 g.
- **Sandwich:** a bun about 10 cm across and 4–5 cm tall, with what looks like a fried chicken patty inside. I estimate 140 g.
- **Sushi:** four pieces in total. Two are plain crab rolls, about 25 g each. Two are tempura-style or fried rolls, about 30 g each. That makes roughly 50 g of plain rolls and 60 g of fried rolls.
